source.label: FY2025 Form 20-F, Part VII Additional Information, Employees
source.quote: The following table sets forth the total number of employees and a breakdown of employees by main category of activity and geographic location, as of the dates indicated. DECEMBER 31, 2023 2024 2025 NUMBER OF EMPLOYEES 179,792 178,468 177,711

notes: Employees: total at December 31, 2025, from the 20-F's employees table. Payroll is null: the 20-F gives no total of wages, salaries or personnel expense (labor costs are mentioned only qualitatively in the operating-results discussion; Note 18 Employee Benefits covers only pension, other post-employment and long-term benefit obligations; the cash-flow statement shows only employee profit sharing paid, Ps.3,131,168 thousand, which is a statutory profit share, not payroll), and as a foreign private issuer América Móvil publishes no CEO pay ratio or median employee pay.
